_comment: Human-curated backlog of real, searched HVAC problems. The daily generator works through these top-to-bottom, skipping any already published or parked in content-rejected.json. Order = priority: furnace fault codes first (heating season), then furnace symptoms, heat pumps, ACs, thermostats, mini splits. Codes come from manufacturer LED/display tables (Carrier=Bryant boards, Goodman=Amana boards, Trane=American Standard boards; Lennox E-codes; York flash codes); the AI reviewer and the human review PR verify each code's meaning. Entries tagged _source=queue were inserted from real visitor searches.
